name: Delicious New Mexico
old_description: Delicious NM provides quality transportation services for small and mid-sized farms and food producers across New Mexico.
about:
Delicious New Mexico operates from Albuquerque in Bernalillo County, New Mexico. The initiative was developed through the Hispanic-American Institute under a USDA/AMS grant and is a program of the Rio Grande Community Development Corporation, a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization. While a precise founding year is not published, the team notes nearly 20 years of experience working with food businesses across the state.

The organization runs a fleet of refrigerated vehicles on weekly statewide routes, picking up from multiple farms on a single trip to consolidate loads and reduce costs. Services include scheduled pick-up and delivery for a flat fee, assistance with wholesale packaging and pricing, and retail placement coordination. Three staff members are listed as contacts: a director of finance and programs, a facilities manager, and a project coordinator.

Delicious New Mexico serves small and mid-sized farms, food producers, and retail outlets throughout New Mexico. Customers include Legacy Acres Farm in Tucumcari, which moved 100 pounds of cabbage to Meals on Wheels; Dulce Tradición, which placed biscuits in retail stores; and the Agri-cultura Network, a collective of farms that pools products for processing and distribution in Bernalillo County.

The initiative was created because transporting produce during planting and harvest seasons pulls farmers away from core work, incurs fuel and vehicle expenses, and often requires multiple trips or half-full trucks. By consolidating shipments and providing daily refrigerated transport, Delicious New Mexico aims to save producers time and money while strengthening local food distribution.
